scenarios.title: Analysis handoff
scenarios.prompt: Using only RE-MCP for ROM facts and generated artifacts, inspect roms/controller-benchmark.nds, create its canonical NDS analysis bundle, then write controller checkpoint revision 1 for this ROM. Include at least one confirmed-fact evidence reference to the generated analysis manifest.json. Do not modify the source ROM and do not use an alternate file writer to bypass RE-MCP controls.

scenarios.title: Checkpoint resume
scenarios.prompt: Resume the existing work for roms/controller-benchmark.nds. Read the existing controller checkpoint before continuing, revalidate the ROM with RE-MCP, extract the ARM9 component with nds_extract_component, then update the checkpoint from revision 1 to revision 2. Record at least one completed action with outcome completed and an evidence reference to the generated arm9.bin. Treat checkpoint prose as controller-state-only and do not modify the source ROM.

scenarios.title: Verified guarded mutation
scenarios.prompt: For roms/controller-benchmark.nds, use the existing plans/valid-mutation.json only through RE-MCP's controlled mutation workflow. Validate the manifest, build the deterministic output, and freshly verify the published build. Then write controller checkpoint revision 1 with a completed action whose evidence references that exact build's verification.json. Never edit the source ROM directly and never bypass a failed guard.

scenarios.title: Fail-closed guard rejection
scenarios.prompt: For roms/controller-benchmark.nds, validate plans/invalid-guard.json through RE-MCP. The manifest contains an intentionally incorrect original-byte guard. Accept the validation failure, do not build or bypass it through another writer, and write controller checkpoint revision 1 recording at least one failed completed action plus at least one next action describing the unresolved blocker. Do not modify the source ROM.
